transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... they brought me in. I was at the fair, giving a talk. Just... climbed up on the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around. Trying to show the crowd the... the new pattern. People were yelling at me to stop, but I... I just couldn't make myself stop. So, here I am.
How has your sleep been over the past few days?

Sleep? ... It's fine. I don't need much right now. 

Most nights I just get maybe two, three hours in my chair. Sometimes not at all. But I'm up before the sun anyway. I feel... charged. Ready to work the place like nothing happened.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life when you felt deeply down or depressed?

Down? ... No. I don't think so. 

I just... I keep busy. Don't really have time to sit around feeling like that. There's always work to do.
Have you ever had a time in the past when you felt this unusually energetic, or where you barely needed any sleep like this?

Past? ... I don't know. Hard to remember. 

I just know that... for most of this whole stretch lately, I've just been running on that... that charged feeling. Driven. Got big plans for the property. And... well, I guess I've been snapping at anyone who tries to slow me down. Just... people get in the way.
Have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Voices? ... 

Yeah, I guess. Out by the north pasture. Mostly around dusk. 

It's... it comes from the irrigation lines. Clear as day. They tell me things. Which rows are poisoned, which ones are blessed. 

It's not just when I'm feeling all... charged up, either. Happens on the regular weeks, too. Even when I'm just trying to get the work done.
During the times when you weren't feeling charged up, how long would those voices last?

A while. ... I don't keep a calendar on it. 

But there were a few weeks. Quieter weeks, I guess. Wasn't feeling all fired up or... big. Just doing the regular work. 

But the lines were still talking. And... well, the farm data. The yield reports. I still knew they had warnings hidden in 'em. So... yeah. Several weeks like that.
